latest_release.name: v.1.0.0
latest_release.body:
🎉🤖   Stable 1.0.0   🤖🎉

It's been a while but we're excited to announce the AgentGPT 1.0 ✨ update! The first stable release of AgentGPT includes new tools, bug fixes, and a completely overhauled ui! Check our the full release notes below 👇 Much the @Reworkd team been focusing on a platform outside of AgentGPT. This new platform aims to use AI to take actions on websites and retrieve information. If this is interesting to you, please fill out [this form](https://6h6bquxo5g1.typeform.com/to/qscfsOf1) explaining your use case! We are looking forward to sharing it with the opensource community! https://github.com/reworkd/AgentGPT/assets/32209255/8f15a3d2-ed9a-436f-b119-d9c311531975 ## ✨ Highlights - 🚀 A freshly redesigned theme - 🔎 Updated agents with a focus on information retrieval through search - 🦥 A new tool for personalized context and queries that take information from Notion/Google Drive/etc powerd by @sidhq - 📈 Increased usage limits for all users - 🤖 Automatic name generation ## ❤️ New Contributors * @yordis made their first contribution in https://github.com/reworkd/AgentGPT/pull/1120 * @KhoomeiK made their first contribution in https://github.com/reworkd/AgentGPT/pull/1146 * @flyi made their first contribution in https://github.com/reworkd/AgentGPT/pull/1155 * @HashCookie made their first contribution in https://github.com/reworkd/AgentGPT/pull/1194 * @gvilums made their first contribution in https://github.com/reworkd/AgentGPT/pull/1244 * @AkashDeep000 made their first contribution in https://github.com/reworkd/AgentGPT/pull/1272 * @sohamtembhurne made their first contribution in https://github.com/reworkd/AgentGPT/pull/1331 * @cstrnt made their first contribution in https://github.com/reworkd/AgentGPT/pull/1333 ## 👀 What's Changed * ✨Removed white lines from 'AI' on landing by @shahrishabh7 in https://github.com/reworkd/AgentGPT/pull/1090 * ✨new sparkle icon added by @shahrishabh7 in https://github.com/reworkd/AgentGPT/pull/1092 * 🙈 conditional video load by @shahrishabh7 in https://github.com/reworkd/AgentGPT/pull/1093 * ᛘ Frontend logic for the IfNode
